zh-CN.title: 广场视频浏览体验升级
items: 广场发言与聊天中的发言卡片现在使用轻量视频缩略图，不再提前加载视频本体
沉浸播放支持 0.75 至 3 倍速循环切换，播放与暂停仍可在画面中央操作

en.title: Improved Square video browsing
items: Square posts and shared post cards now use lightweight video thumbnails without preloading the video
Immersive playback now cycles from 0.75x to 3x while play and pause remain centered
